title: Provoking speeches or gestures.
bodyText: Any person subject to this chapter who uses provoking or reproachful words or gestures towards any other person subject to this chapter shall be punished as directed by a court-martial.
bodyHtml: [§124B-183]  Provoking speeches or gestures.  Any person subject to this chapter who uses provoking or reproachful words or gestures towards any other person subject to this chapter shall be punished as directed by a court-martial. [L 2022, c 286, pt of §2]
